name: op_image_cache_id_repaints
description: O1 CONTENT-OVERLAY INVARIANT (css-id arm): registering an image under a CSS id that a mounted node's background-image: url(...) already references must take effect NOW — not 'on the next unrelated relayout'. This pins the AddImageToCache DoNothing bug: the handler returned DoNothing, so a css-id registration became visible only when something else happened to relayout; RemoveImageFromCache likewise. After O1 the chokepoint computes which nodes resolve the id (reverse index) and returns the correct dirty tier. Before O1 this scenario is RED twice over: the headless runner declares AddImageToCache 'unsupported' (hard failure), and even the DLL path repainted nothing. LIVENESS on add, LIVENESS on remove (back to the plain background), soundness both ways.

css: #imgbox { width: 80px; height: 60px; background: blue; background-image: url("e2e-live-img"); }
